data.definitions:
- **Arrivals at a stop:** inferred arrivals of every route that serves the stop, all hours, both service days pooled (see On-time performance for how an arrival is inferred).
- **On time:** the share of those arrivals at most 1 min early and at most 5 min late.
- **Stop ID:** the MTA's own identifier. Each direction of a street has its own stop and its own ID.
- **Scored:** stops with at least 10 arrivals; the others are drawn hollow and not compared.
- **Background:** bus and subway route shapes from the MTA static timetables, drawn without map tiles.
